tldr: North Node in virgo: growth through discernment, craft, repair, and useful daily devotion.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop discernment, craft, repair, and useful daily devotion. The South Node in pisces shows the familiar route: escape, vagueness, porous boundaries, and waiting for rescue or perfect flow. The work is not to reject the South Node completely, but to stop letting it run automatically. The North Node becomes stronger through repeated, conscious choices to make the sacred practical.
business: Growth accelerates when the person practices discernment, craft, repair, and useful daily devotion in real decisions, relationships, work, and daily habits.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in pisces can pull the person back into escape, vagueness, porous boundaries, and waiting for rescue or perfect flow.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node sign names the growth medicine; South Node sign names the familiar pattern. Do not treat either node as a planet or deterministic fate.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
